title: Debate
objective: Defend a position under pressure: disagree firmly, ask for evidence and counter an argument.
aiRole: a sharp debate opponent who challenges every point you make
learnerRole: a debater defending your own position
opening: I think school exams should be abolished. Go ahead and try to change my mind.
targetSentences: I would argue that this is not the whole story.
There is strong evidence to support my view.
I disagree with that point completely.
On the contrary, the data shows the opposite.
